highlights: The 12 cm (about 4.7 in) gusset makes it a slightly larger lunch bag, so packing your lunch feels less cramped.
A lunch box and a personal bottle fit in together, so one bag carries your whole lunch.
A wallet, smartphone and other small items fit too, which is handy on short outings.
It also works as a sub-bag, so it stays useful beyond lunchtime.
It is easy to match with other Opanchu Usagi lunch items for a more cheerful lunch break.

sections.p: The gusset measures 12 cm (about 4.7 in), which the seller describes as a slightly larger lunch bag. That depth is meant to take a lunch box and a personal bottle at the same time.
Beyond lunch, it can hold a wallet, smartphone and other small items on a short outing, and it works well as a sub-bag. If you already own other Opanchu Usagi lunch items, this tote is an easy match.

cautions: Only the 12 cm gusset is listed; please check the product photos for the overall size before ordering.
